reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: Nb is lighter and chemically similar to Ta, and prior work on refractory HEAs supports that Nb-for-Ta substitution can preserve the BCC phase and strength while reducing density.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes specific, measurable rejection criteria (density reduction <3%, >10% loss in strength/ductility, phase instability), making it decisive.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, directly actionable hypothesis that addresses the core trade-off (density vs. high-temperature strength) with a well-defined experiment and falsification criteria.
